bifrost: none at SDK level. Partial pieces: springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs (Location struct :116, GEOCODE_API :25, parse_places :253); springboard/src/shell/photos/exif.rs (format_gps :110, read_gps :324)
summary: Apple's framework gives apps device position, heading, geofences, beacons and geocoding behind a permission prompt. BifrOSt has no device position source, no location permission and no SDK location API; the only related code is forward place-name geocoding inside the Weather app and EXIF GPS reading in Photos.

features.apple: CLLocationManager, CLLocationUpdate, CLBackgroundActivitySession, CLServiceSession (Getting the current location of a device; Handling location updates in the background)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/core_location.rs (LocationManager, Delegate, Location, accuracy levels, distance filter); springboard/src/shell/services/location.rs (shell location service: manual location from Settings prefs, IP lookup off by default)
features.note: Tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-16.rs (authorization replies, update and failure delivery, distance filter, decoding, error codes, usage texts); not yet checked on Midget. Authorization state machine runs through the privacy grants (notDetermined to authorizedWhenInUse or denied); requestLocation, start/stopUpdatingLocation, didUpdateLocations and didFailWithError are delivered to a delegate. No GPS hardware and no Wi-Fi positioning: a fix is a manual location (100 m) or an opt-in IP lookup (about 25 km, city level). No altitude, no background updates, no CLLocationUpdate/CLServiceSession.

features.apple: CLAuthorizationStatus, CLAccuracyAuthorization, NSLocation*UsageDescription keys, Requesting authorization, Suspending authorization requests
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/location_auth.rs; wired: springboard/ui/src/location_auth.rs (shell privacy service: location_status, location_request; Settings > Privacy > App Permissions > LOCATION switch; SDK privacy_permissions::location_status/location_request/decode_location/decode_location_outcome); wired: springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src/insights.rs (location_note) and weather.rs LOCATION, place_rows footer; wired: springboard/src/shell/services/privacy_permissions.rs (location_request queues the sheet)
features.note: Authorization status, accuracy, usage texts and error codes are tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-17.rs. The shell privacy service, the SDK privacy client and the weather app use this model for the Settings switch and the request sheet; not yet verified on Midget. Gap: the manifest permission list (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs) has no location entry, so apps cannot declare a location use.

A saved place is a public struct in the shell's Weather data module with a name, region, latitude and longitude, and a two-decimal cache key; the values, the saved list and the key are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-21.rs. Gap: no accuracy, timestamp, altitude, course, speed, floor or visit data, and no SDK type.

features.apple: CLGeocoder (geocodeAddressString), CLPlacemark, Converting between coordinates and user-friendly place names
features.note: The place-name request is trimmed, percent-encoded and asks for six English matches, and each answer becomes a name, region and coordinates; tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-21.rs. Gap: only the Weather app's data module uses it, not springboard/sdk/src, and no placemark carries address parts.

features.apple: CLGeocoder (reverseGeocodeLocation), CLPlacemark, Converting a user's location to a descriptive placemark
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/reverse_lookup.rs (Place; springboard/sdk/src/core_location.rs reverse_geocode/decode_placemark over the location service reverse method
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. The Open-Meteo search in data.rs goes from text to coordinates only. City-level reverse lookup of the manual and IP places within 50 km (no worldwide gazetteer); host-tested only.

features.apple: CLMonitor, CLCondition, CLRegion, Monitoring the user's proximity to geographic regions
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. Wave 2 (core-location, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No geofence or condition monitor. docs/bifrost-ui.md (Notifications gaps paragraph) lists calendar and location triggers for notifications as not implemented. round 75, host only: circular geofence monitor fed by the caller, no position source.

features.apple: CLBeacon, CLBeaconRegion (deprecated), CLBeaconIdentityConstraint (deprecated), Ranging for Beacons, Turning an iOS device into an iBeacon device
features.bifrost: none for iBeacon. springboard/src/net/share.rs:52 (Beacon) is LAN device discovery over UDP
features.note: The BifrOSt beacon in net/share.rs (BEACON_PORT 5354, springboard/src/net/share.rs:34) announces a sharing peer on the local network. It is not BLE iBeacon. iBeacon needs Bluetooth LE advertising and ranging, which no SDK API exposes. Marked n/a only because the framework is Apple-specific and deprecated; the proximity use case is a gap.

features.apple: CLHeading, CLBodyIdentifiable, Getting heading and course information
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 2 (theme-27, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The shell reads the accelerometer for screen rotation only. There is no magnetometer heading, no true or magnetic north value and no course data for apps.

features.apple: CLLocationPushServiceExtension, CLLocationPushServiceError, Location Push Service Extension entitlement
features.note: Depends on Apple push infrastructure and an Apple entitlement. No BifrOSt counterpart.

features.feature: Location metadata in photos (not Core Location)
features.apple: No direct equivalent in Core Location; photo GPS is read through ImageIO
features.note: Photos reads GPS tags from JPEG EXIF and formats them as coordinates. It is read-only, has no SDK API and does not write GPS tags. Headless tests in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-07.rs: headless_gps_is_formatted_as_unsigned_degrees_with_hemisphere_letters, headless_gps_tags_are_read_from_the_jpeg_and_signed_by_their_references, headless_out_of_range_gps_is_dropped, headless_reader_rejects_non_jpeg_bytes_and_keeps_the_file_size_fallback, headless_capture_date_and_exposure_are_formatted_for_the_info_sheet.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 6 (b04, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. No location error domain or diagnostics exist. They depend on the missing location manager. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity.

gaps: No device position source: no GPS, Wi-Fi positioning or geoclue client in springboard/src or netd. Nothing produces a CLLocation-like value.
No location permission in the app manifest and no authorization prompt or status (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs:34).
No SDK module for location in springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (no location module among the pub mod list).
No reverse geocoding (coordinates to placemark). Forward search exists only inside the Weather app (springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs:253).
No geofence or region monitoring and no location triggers for notifications (docs/bifrost-ui.md, Notifications gaps).
No magnetometer heading or course for apps (springboard/src/shell/rotate.rs reads the accelerometer only).
No background location session or live update stream for apps.
